lines.zh: 我抬着一片叶子往回走
lines.en: I carry a leaf back.
My steps are lighter than the others'.
I walk near the back of the column.
Pollen clings to me.

lines.zh: 我不住地蹭自己的触角
lines.en: I keep rubbing my antennae.
I go around a stone without stopping.
A grain of sand on my red shell.

lines.zh: 我走在最外侧，护着里面
lines.en: I take the outside, guarding the rest.
There is something held in my mandibles.
I follow the familiar route.
The one ahead slows; so do I.
I test the way with my antennae.

lines.zh: 我的影子很短，贴在草上
lines.en: My shadow is short, flat on the grass.

lines.zh: 我在队伍和巢之间来回
lines.en: I go back and forth between column and nest.
Halfway there, I pause for breath.
I carry the nest's scent.
I set the leaf down and tidy it.
I wait for the shift change.
My antennae sweep the air.

lines.zh: 这里的草被我们踩平了
lines.en: The grass here is trampled by us.
I keep looking toward the nest.
My mandibles grind slowly.
A comrade steps over me.

lines.zh: 我在清点搬回来的东西
lines.en: I am taking stock of what we brought.
An old crack on my shell.
I neither call nor make a sound.
I scrape the mud off my legs.
I rest by the nest, antennae twitching.
I stop, antennae pointed at you.
You are blocking the carrying path.
I go half around you.
You are watching us work.
I cannot drop what I carry.
I am not one of the leaders.
My mandibles are still full.
You look at me and I slow down.

lines.zh: 我和巢之间还有一段路
lines.en: There is still a stretch between me and the nest.
I dropped what I carried.
Another crack on my shell.
I roll to the base of the grass.
One leg is bent.
First I look for the thing I dropped.
I do not call; I save strength.
A comrade rights me.
This is nothing much.
I can still carry.
The work is not done.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西不是我们的
lines.en: What you hold is not ours.
I already have work in my hands.
Put it down; I have carrying to do.
This is not our way.
Set it on the ground, do not hand it to me.
I stopped and looked.
The smell is wrong; no.
I only carry what the nest wants.
I've still got work in hand
I will go around.
What I carried fell.
I hurry to pick it up.
You stepped on my leg.

lines.zh: 我退开，护住颚里的东西
lines.en: I back off, guarding what is in my mouth.
That spun me half around.
The comrades beside me stopped too.
I shake the dirt off my shell.
Do not step; I am right at your feet.
I slip past along the ground.
The nest has one for that.
I am the one who carries.
We each do our own work.
I walk the same route every day.
An antenna touch is enough.
I do not leave the column.
There is no strength to spare here.
My work is not finished.
Back to carrying.
I take two and carry both.
This is heavier than I am.
I set it down and change my grip.
A comrade comes to help.
The nest wants this.
The nest does not want that.
I balance it on my head.
If it drops, the trip is wasted.
We lift it together.
Stones in the road; careful.
You crushed what I was carrying.
I set down my work.
I sent a signal.
Comrades are coming this way.
I stand in the middle of the path.
Move out past the grass.

lines.zh: 我的颚平时用来搬东西
lines.en: My mandibles are for carrying.
But they can bite too.
Fighting is not my work.
But I will not run.
The nest is right behind me.
Past me lies the nest.
The sound of my wings stays right behind you.
I keep sending signals.
Comrades wait ahead.
The way you walk leads to the nest.
I track along the grass roots.
I count how many times you stamp.
There is a slope ahead.
Behind the slope there is nothing.
I need not call; scent carries.
The whole column knows now.
Soon.
I bite your heel from down low.

lines.zh: 这一下是为了搬的东西
lines.en: That was for the load.
I come up from below.
My mandibles clamp your boot.
I am weak, but I hold tight.
The comrades lunge in too.
I gave ground on that one.
I circle at your feet.
I flatten a patch of grass.
I am still signaling.
I come from the nest side.
The nest's smell is still on me.
I have taken on a new errand.
The column passed here just now.
First I tested the road ahead.
Red light darkens the grass.
I set down the old, take up the new.
I count the comrades.

lines.zh: 我的触角碰到一个信号
lines.en: My antennae caught a signal.
I walk in along the scent.
Fire passes over my shell, burning.
I drop off a grass blade.
Water rolls me over.

lines.zh: 冲击把我和东西一起掀飞
lines.en: The blast throws me and my load.

lines.zh: 那力量让我手里的东西掉了
lines.en: That force makes me drop my load.
Hungry, but the load comes first.
Lightning falls and my legs lock.
No nest here, and no road.
